title: Let’s keep doing lunch: Hong Kong exchange leans towards keeping noon break, sources say
summary: Lunch is likely to remain on the menu for Hong Kong stock brokers, as the city’s bourse operator leans towards extending trading hours at either end of the day while keeping the market’s traditional mid-day break intact, according to multiple sources. title: More than 50% of Americans believe China is winning. So does the rest of the world
summary: More than half of Americans believe China has already overtaken or will eventually surpass the United States in technology, economic strength and even military power, according to a study based on US public opinion data. The proportions reached 68.8 per cent in technology, 65.2 per cent in economic strength and 58.3 per cent in military power. summary: Film star ⁠Gerard Depardieu, one of the ⁠leading faces of French cinema, will face trial on charges of raping actress Charlotte Arnould in 2018, after a Paris appeal court on Thursday rejected his bid to avoid having the case tried. title: Spain’s Pablo Hernandez de Cos to succeed Lagarde as European Central Bank chief
summary: Spain’s Pablo Hernandez de Cos will be the next head of the European Central Bank, taking over from Christine Lagarde, diplomats said on Thursday. His nomination comes at a time of tension on European bond markets and before a series of high-stakes elections in Europe next year, including in France. Hernandez de Cos, 55, has been head of the Swiss-based Bank for International Settlements (BIS) since last year, and previously led the Bank of Spain from 2018 to 2024. title: UK man convicted of knife rampage on London-bound train
summary: A man who went on the rampage armed with a knife on a London-bound train was on Thursday found guilty of the attempted murder of 14 people. A jury found Anthony Williams, 33, guilty of all 10 counts of attempted murder on the train involving passengers and an on-board staff member, as well as earlier incidents in London and another UK town in which four others were injured. title: EU leaders unable to agree on budget after over 12 hours of talks: ‘zero results’
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron set an end-of-year deadline for an agreement on the European Union’s next seven-year budget after the continent’s leaders ruled out any chances for a deal to be reached at their summit on Thursday. The 2028-2034 budget – a statement on broader EU ambitions – is small, compared to national budgets, and it is financed mostly by the 27 member countries based on the size of their economies. title: Trump calls GDP figures ‘fake’, demands probe of own Commerce Department
summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday accused his Commerce Department of purposely issuing incorrect economic growth figures before the midterm elections and said he wants to launch an investigation.
